rows.section: Personal income tax (személyi jövedelemadó, SZJA)
rows.basis: Consolidated tax base (összevont adóalap), per year
rows.note: One flat rate on wages, self-employment income and other consolidated income; there is no tax-free allowance for everyone. The allowances below reduce the tax base in the order set by § 29/H.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról (Personal Income Tax Act), version in force from 1 October 2026, § 8

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Family allowance (családi kedvezmény), 1 dependant: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 20,001 of tax a month
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/A

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Family allowance, 2 dependants: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 39,999 of tax a month per child
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/A

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Family allowance, 3 or more dependants: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 66,000 of tax a month per child
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/A

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Family allowance supplement for a long-term ill or severely disabled child, per month
rows.note: Allowances reduce the tax base, so each forint of allowance saves 15 fillér of tax. The family allowance counts dependants (e.g. students) but is claimed only for beneficiary dependants, and spouses or partners may share it.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/A

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Family contribution credit (családi járulékkedvezmény): share of the unused family allowance
rows.note: reduces the employee's 18.5% contribution (or the 10% pension contribution) when the tax base is too small
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények (personal income tax base allowances), published 19 March 2026, section 11

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: First-marriage allowance (első házasok kedvezménye), per couple per month
rows.note: saves HUF 5,000 of tax a month; at least one spouse in a first marriage, no age limit
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/C

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: First-marriage allowance: months after the wedding
rows.note: Allowances reduce the tax base, so each forint of allowance saves 15 fillér of tax. The family allowance counts dependants (e.g. students) but is claimed only for beneficiary dependants, and spouses or partners may share it.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/C

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Personal allowance for the severely disabled (személyi kedvezmény), per month
rows.note: one third of the minimum wage rounded to HUF 100; saves HUF 16,140 of tax a month
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/E

rows.section: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal
rows.label: Order of the allowances (§ 29/H)
rows.value: 1. mothers under 30; 2. mothers of four or more, three or two children; 3. CSED, GYED and adoption benefit allowance; 4. under-25 allowance; 5. personal allowance; 6. first-marriage allowance; 7. family allowance
rows.note: Allowances reduce the tax base, so each forint of allowance saves 15 fillér of tax. The family allowance counts dependants (e.g. students) but is claimed only for beneficiary dependants, and spouses or partners may share it.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/H

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Under-25 allowance (25 év alatti fiatalok kedvezménye): maximum per month
rows.note: saves HUF 107,365 of tax a month; the July 2025 average gross earnings
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 7 (25 év alatti fiatalok kedvezménye)

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Under-25 allowance: maximum per year
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 7 (25 év alatti fiatalok kedvezménye)

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Under-25 allowance: age limit (until the month of the birthday)
rows.note: EEA nationals and nationals of non-EEA neighbouring countries; employment and listed self-employment income
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 7 (25 év alatti fiatalok kedvezménye)

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Mothers under 30 (30 év alatti anyák kedvezménye)
rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit from 2026: mothers entitled to the family allowance for their own or adopted child (or a foetus from day 91), until the year they turn 30
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 2 (30 év alatti anyák kedvezménye)

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Mothers of four or more children (NÉTAK)
rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit on employment and listed self-employment income
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/D

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Mothers of three children (három gyermeket nevelő anyák kedvezménye)
rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit from 1 October 2025; the Act sets no age condition
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2025. évi XV. törvény a három gyermeket nevelő anyák kedvezményéről (Act XV of 2025 on the allowance for mothers raising three children)

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: Mothers of two children (két gyermeket nevelő anyák kedvezménye)
rows.value: From 1 January 2026, no upper limit, phased in by age: in 2026 mothers under 40 (born in 1986 or later), from 2027 under 50, from 2028 under 60, from 2029 all ages
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2025. évi XIV. törvény a két gyermeket nevelő anyák kedvezményéről (Act XIV of 2025 on the allowance for mothers raising two children), version in force from 1 January 2026, § 3-4

rows.section: Exemptions for young people and mothers
rows.label: CSED, GYED and adoption benefit allowance
rows.value: Since 1 July 2025 these childcare benefits are free of income tax (an allowance equal to the benefit, applied by the paying body)
rows.note: The mothers' exemptions count children for whom the mother receives (or received for at least 12 years) the family benefit (családi pótlék). They cover wages and listed self-employment income, not rental or capital income; the 18.5% contribution is still due.
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 6 (CSED, GYED and adoption benefit allowance)

rows.label: Social security contribution (társadalombiztosítási járulék), total

rows.label: Minimum monthly contribution base (járulékfizetési alsó határ), employees
rows.note: 30% of the minimum wage; the employer pays the contribution on the shortfall

rows.section: Employer contributions (szociális hozzájárulási adó, szocho)
rows.label: Social contribution tax (szociális hozzájárulási adó)
rows.note: on the same base as the employee contribution

rows.section: Employer contributions (szociális hozzájárulási adó, szocho)
rows.label: Minimum monthly base for employees (30% of the minimum wage)
rows.note: The social contribution tax is paid on top of gross pay. Targeted reliefs exist, e.g. for labour market entrants and staff with reduced working capacity.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2019. évi CXXII. törvény (Tbj.), version in force from 1 October 2026, § 27 (2)

rows.section: Employer contributions (szociális hozzájárulási adó, szocho)
rows.label: Rehabilitation contribution (rehabilitációs hozzájárulás), per missing person per year
rows.note: 9× the minimum wage; employers with more than 25 staff of whom fewer than 5% have reduced working capacity
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 94: Rehabilitációs hozzájárulás (rehabilitation contribution), published 12 January 2026, sections 1 and 5

rows.section: Employer contributions (szociális hozzájárulási adó, szocho)
rows.label: Sick pay contribution (táppénz-hozzájárulás)
rows.value: One third of the sickness benefit paid to the employee
rows.note: The social contribution tax is paid on top of gross pay. Targeted reliefs exist, e.g. for labour market entrants and staff with reduced working capacity.

rows.label: Minimum wage (minimálbér), per month, full time
rows.note: Set by government decree 426/2025. (XII. 23.) from 1 January 2026; the decree also gives weekly (HUF 74,210 / 85,800) and daily (HUF 14,850 / 17,160) amounts. Many 2026 amounts derive from the monthly minimum wage.

rows.note: Income = revenue less the cost ratio. Contributions (18.5%) and the social contribution tax (13%) are due on the flat-rate income with the monthly minimum bases; a secondary-activity sole trader pays no contribution while the flat-rate income stays within the tax-free part.

rows.section: KATA (kisadózó vállalkozók tételes adója, fixed-rate tax for small sole traders)
rows.label: Who can use it (2026)
rows.value: Full-time sole traders only, selling to private individuals: KATA status ends on revenue from a business payer (domestic or foreign; taxi services excepted) or from renting out property; not for employees of 36+ hours a week, pensioners or full-time students
rows.note: KATA under Act XIII of 2022 applies in 2026 (NAV information booklet 99, 20 February 2026); the fixed tax is due for every started month.

rows.note: A 0% rate applies to daily newspapers (annex 3/B). Businesses established in Hungary under the limit can opt out of VAT; they then charge no VAT and cannot deduct input VAT.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Income tax for sole traders
rows.value: Átalányadózás (15% on revenue less a 45%, 80% or 90% cost ratio, first HUF 1,936,800 tax free), KATA, or 9% entrepreneurial income tax on profit
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: KIVA (kisvállalati adó), for companies
rows.value: 10% on personal payments (pay) plus the balance of capital and dividend movements, replacing corporate tax and the social contribution tax; companies with up to 100 staff and HUF 6 billion revenue (exit above 200 staff or HUF 12 billion)
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: NAV information booklet 92: Kisvállalati adó szabályozása (small business tax, KIVA), published 18 May 2026

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: residents (Hungarian citizens, EEA nationals with 183 days in the year, holders of long-term residence, or anyone whose home or centre of vital interests is in Hungary) pay the 15% rate on worldwide income; the Act has no relief for new residents
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 2 (4) and § 3 point 2

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: White Card (Fehér Kártya) for digital nomads
rows.value: Residence permit for non-EEA nationals employed abroad or owning a profitable business abroad who work remotely from Hungary; no work for Hungarian employers and no share in a Hungarian business
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Országos Idegenrendészeti Főigazgatóság (OIF): Fehér Kártya – digitális nomád tartózkodás (White Card for digital nomads)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: White Card: income requirement
rows.value: Net EUR 3,000 a month in each of the 6 months before the application, and throughout the stay
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Országos Idegenrendészeti Főigazgatóság (OIF): Fehér Kártya – digitális nomád tartózkodás (White Card for digital nomads)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: White Card: duration
rows.value: Up to 1 year, extendable once by up to 1 year; decision within 30 days; no switch to another permit in Hungary
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Országos Idegenrendészeti Főigazgatóság (OIF): Fehér Kártya – digitális nomád tartózkodás (White Card for digital nomads)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: White Card: tax consequence
rows.value: No special regime: a holder who becomes tax resident (home, centre of vital interests or habitual abode in Hungary) pays Hungarian income tax on worldwide income, subject to tax treaties
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 2 (4) and § 3 point 2

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: White Card: a Hungarian consulate abroad, or in Hungary through Enter Hungary for visa-free nationals (National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing, OIF); KATA, átalányadózás and sole-trader registration: NAV (Vállalkozói Ügysegéd)
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by NAV; the White Card figures are those of the OIF and the implementing decree.
rows.source_title: Országos Idegenrendészeti Főigazgatóság (OIF): Fehér Kártya – digitális nomád tartózkodás (White Card for digital nomads)
